apps.name: Own Calendar
apps.subtitle: Unified family calendar
apps.localizedDescription:
Own Calendar brings all your schedules into one place. Sync with Naver Calendar, Google Calendar, and TickTick. Share calendars with your family effortlessly.

Features:
- Unified calendar view (Naver, Google, TickTick)
- Bidirectional sync with Google Calendar
- Family group sharing
- Past event search
- iOS home screen widgets
- Self-hosted — you own your data

permissions.usageDescription: Connects to your self-hosted Own Calendar server for syncing events and family sharing.
Refreshes widget data and syncs calendar events in the background.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial release with unified calendar view, family sharing, and home screen widgets.
